name: E6 alternative route
description_md:
The E6 alternative route is an international waymarked hiking route located in GR. This trail covers a distance of 1255.3 km with 32478 m of ascent and 32479 m of descent.

The route is classified as hard due to the total distance and elevation gain. Walking the path requires about 400 hours based on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The trail passes within 600 m of the Byzantine Museum, 700 m of Kastoria, and 900 m of Saint George on the Hill Church.
